The honest promise

Free means free—not “free trial.”

Every recommendation here has a genuinely usable free tier, not a demo that watermarks your client work. Free plans still have limits, and you should always know where the export button lives.

01

A real free tier

Enough of the core job to run a one-person business, not a countdown timer. No invented urgency, no affiliate links.

02

Your data can leave

Export, back up, and replace. A free tool that holds your only copy of the books is not a bargain.

03

Humans when it matters

Free advising from the Indiana SBDC, SCORE, and SBA—plus a clear line around what free tools cannot decide.
